name: branding-blue-to-orange-gradient-rounded-wordmark
title: Geometric lowercase wordmark fading from sky blue to orange
whatItIs: A white slide with 'dopamine' in lowercase rounded geometric letters with cut-out details, coloured by a smooth gradient from pale blue on the left through grey to orange on the right, with the i's dot in orange.
whatItMeans: Bright and energetic; the colour shift hints at mood or reward.
techniques: Apply a single left-to-right gradient across a wordmark.
Use geometric letters with small cuts for character.
Make the tittle a solid dot in the end colour.

vocabulary.definition: A logo filled with a colour blend.
Letterforms built from circles and lines.
The dot over an i or j.
A gradient from blue to orange.
